items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: when somebody is laying out and Harvey is talking to the boys about

ctx.x: Because you're into it, you understand. So -- and now he's exposed on the bandstand. When the music is -- when somebody is laying out and Harvey is talking to the boys about, when you're done you don't die, because you go on. And you change bodies and -- but you go on. And these things -- maybe I believe it now, but at that time, -- for for Augie, and it was the fourth night, we just started playing. And Augie was not the kind of guy that you could talk to. He was dour, that kind of -- I mean, you would have to…

want to say nothing. And he packs the drums and calls a cab and hauls him out to the South Side, 1800 or somewhere, where some gangsters, where he can go to work as a bartender, which is what he did, and just put the drums down.
